title: 3dDWItoDT
description: Computes 6 principal direction tensors from multiple gradient vectors and corresponding DTI image volumes.

gradient_file.description: A 1D file of the gradient vectors with lines of ASCII floats (Gxi, Gyi, Gzi) or a 1D file of b-matrix elements.
gradient_file.title: Gradient file

dataset.description: A 3D bucket dataset with Np+1 sub-briks where the first sub-brik is the volume acquired with no diffusion weighting.
dataset.title: DTI dataset

prefix.description: Output dataset prefix name. Default is 'DT'.
prefix.title: Output prefix

automask.description: Mask dataset so that tensors are computed only for high-intensity (presumably brain) voxels.
automask.title: Automatic mask

mask.description: Use this dataset as mask to include/exclude voxels.
mask.title: Mask dataset

bmatrix_NZ.description: Input dataset is b-matrix, not gradient directions, and there is no row of zeros at the top of the file.
bmatrix_NZ.title: B-matrix NZ

bmatrix_Z.description: Similar to '-bmatrix_NZ' but first row of the file is all zeros.
bmatrix_Z.title: B-matrix Z

bmatrix_FULL.description: Same as '-bmatrix_Z' but with a more intuitive name.
bmatrix_FULL.title: B-matrix FULL

scale_out_1000.description: Increase output parameters with physical units by multiplying them by 1000.
scale_out_1000.title: Scale output by 1000

bmax_ref.description: Flag the reference b-value if it is greater than zero.
bmax_ref.title: Reference b-value

nonlinear.description: Compute iterative solution to avoid negative eigenvalues. This is the default method.
nonlinear.title: Nonlinear computation

reweight.description: Recompute weight factors at end of iterations and restart.
reweight.title: Recompute weight factors

max_iter.description: Maximum number of iterations for convergence. Default is 10.
max_iter.title: Maximum iterations

max_iter_rw.description: Max number of iterations after reweighting. Default is 5.
max_iter_rw.title: Max iterations after reweighting

eigs.description: Compute eigenvalues, eigenvectors, fractional anisotropy, and mean diffusivity in sub-briks 6-19.
eigs.title: Compute Eigen parameters

debug_briks.description: Add sub-briks with error functional, original error, number of steps to convergence, and modeled B0 volume.
debug_briks.title: Add debugging sub-briks

cumulative_wts.description: Show overall weight factors for each gradient level.
cumulative_wts.title: Show weight factors

verbose.description: Print convergence steps every nnnnn voxels.
verbose.title: Verbose

drive_afni.description: Show convergence graphs every nnnnn voxels. AFNI must have NIML communications on.
drive_afni.title: AFNI drive

sep_dsets.description: Save tensor, eigenvalues, vectors, FA, MD in separate datasets.
sep_dsets.title: Separate datasets

csf_val.description: Assign diffusivity value to DWI data where the mean values for b=0 volumes is less than the mean of the remaining volumes at each voxel.
csf_val.title: CSF diffusivity

min_bad_md.description: Change the min MD value used as a 'badness check' for tensor fits.
min_bad_md.title: Minimum bad MD value

csf_fa.description: Assign a specific FA value to CSF voxels.
csf_fa.title: CSF FA value

mean_b0.description: Use mean of all b=0 volumes for linear computation and initial linear for nonlinear method.
mean_b0.title: Use mean b=0
